            circles[i][0] = ni();
            circles[i][1] = ni();
            circles[i][2] = ni();

                    circles[i][0], circles[i][1], circles[i][2],
                    circles[j][0], circles[j][1], circles[j][2]
                );
                for (double angle : angles) {
                    double x = circles[i][0] + circles[i][2] * Math.cos(angle);
                    double y = circles[i][1] + circles[i][2] * Math.sin(angle);
                    points.add(new double[]{x, y});

            }
            uniquePoints.add(points.get(i));
        }

        int nodeCount = uniquePoints.size();
        int edgeCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int count = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < uniquePoints.size(); j++) {

                if (Math.abs(distSq - circles[i][2] * circles[i][2]) < 1e-9) {

        out.println(edgeCount - nodeCount + 2);

    public static double distanceSquared(double[] a, double[] b) {
        return (a[0] - b[0]) * (a[0] - b[0]) + (a[1] - b[1]) * (a[1] - b[1]);
    }

    public static double distanceSquared(double[] a, long cx, long cy) {
        return (a[0] - cx) * (a[0] - cx) + (a[1] - cy) * (a[1] - cy);
    }

    private static final double EPS = 1e-9;

    public static double[] computeIntersectionAngles(long x1, long y1, long r1, long x2, long y2, long r2) {
        long dx = x2 - x1;
        long dy = y2 - y1;
        long d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        
        if (d2 == 0) {
            // Concentric circles - no intersection points
            return new double[0];
        }
        
        double d = Math.sqrt(d2);
        
        // Check for no intersection
        if (d > r1 + r2 || d < Math.abs(r1 - r2)) {
            return new double[0];
        }
        
        // Check for tangent circles (one intersection point)
        if (Math.abs(d - (r1 + r2)) < EPS || Math.abs(d - Math.abs(r1 - r2)) < EPS) {
            double angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            if (d == Math.abs(r1 - r2) && r1 < r2) {
                angle += Math.PI;
            }
            return new double[]{angle};
        }
        
        double baseAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        double angleOffset = Math.acos((r1 * r1 + d2 - r2 * r2) / (2 * r1 * d));
        
        double lower = baseAngle - angleOffset;
        double upper = baseAngle + angleOffset;
        
        return new double[]{lower, upper};
    }

    private boolean oj = System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") != null;
